effect_on_outcome: The primary source-integrity result remains valid. Network-byte budget compliance is unverified; do not cite this run as measuring wire bytes. The fetch was limited to one pinned depth-one commit, had a 180-second timeout, incurred no paid cost, and completed in 3.92 seconds.
limitation: The protocol named a 512 MiB maximum for downloaded and temporary object bytes. The run enforced the cap against temporary on-disk object/worktree bytes but did not instrument Git transport bytes on the wire. The 3,813,389-byte measurement is temporary filesystem occupancy only.
